title: Dirgha Open GPU Cloud Market Provider Manifest
description: Standard contract for third-party GPU cloud providers (neoclouds, sovereign regional clouds, enterprise private clusters, DePIN networks) submitting their cloud to Dirgha 2.0.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug identifying the GPU cloud provider.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the GPU cloud provider.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS base URL of the provider's GPU orchestration API (private/loopback IPs are rejected).

authHeader.description: HTTP header carrying the caller's API credential (e.g. Authorization or X-API-Key).

authEnvVar.description: Environment variable name from which Dirgha reads the user's BYOK credential at runtime.

jurisdictions.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 or regional residency codes enforced by LOKAHI data residency policies (e.g. IN, EU, US, SG).

catalogPath.description: GET path returning available GPU SKUs ({ gpus: [{ id, name, vramGb, costPerHr, region, available }] }).

provisionPath.description: POST path accepting GPUProvisionConfig and returning GPUInstance.

statusPath.description: GET path template containing {id} returning GPUInstance status.

logsPath.description: GET path template containing {id} returning plain-text instance logs.

destroyPath.description: DELETE path template containing {id} tearing down the instance.
